title: Bugonomics: The Flip Side of Cheap Coding

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
## Editorial pass 2026-08-29

Shipped 2026-08-29. No copywriting work here. Two notes so it stays useful on the board.

**Its remaining value is as a link target.** Bugonomics is the security companion to the cost-collapse piece, and several unshipped stories should be pointing at it. Notably 37add6's "links to existing work" list names Never Use Fast and Maximize Value but **not** this or The Content Paradox. Worth a pass across the in-flight stories to make sure recently shipped work is being linked rather than re-argued.

**Board hygiene.** It sits at `idea`, which reads as "not started" — the exact opposite of true. It cannot reach `published` without walking every gate and writing every artifact, so the mismatch is permanent unless the story is closed. Fine to leave, but a copywriter scanning the board should not mistake this for an unwritten pitch.
